evidence_unit.bounded_claim: EMA publishes PRAC recommendations on safety signals and routes recommendations for regulatory action through accountable governance paths.
evidence_unit.boundary: Governance/process evidence; no signal-detection accuracy, speed or treatment-outcome metric.

evidence_unit.bounded_claim: The HMA–EMA NDSG 2026–2028 workplan plans AI guidance for clinical development and pharmacovigilance.
evidence_unit.boundary: Official planned guidance work; not proof that any specific system is compliant or clinically effective.

evidence_unit.bounded_claim: In a 2026 validation study of 1,085 annotated primary-care encounter notes, the best mean ADE-detection F1 was 72.53% with study-specific confidence bounds.
evidence_unit.boundary: Study-specific primary-care validation; not a production PV SLA, universal performance rate or autonomous safety decision.

evidence_unit.bounded_claim: In a 2026 single-center UCSF study of 372 clinical notes, a two-pass LLM pipeline reported 94.2% ADE-extraction precision with expert validation.
evidence_unit.boundary: Single-center study using one proprietary model; not production performance, universal LLM capability, autonomous signal confirmation or proof of improved outcomes.

mutation_decision.reason: The live page is structurally richer than the repository preview and the form semantics differ. Raw origin HTML/assets are not materialized, current copy-contract metadata is stale, and current placement/presentation judges are unresolved. A 100%-faithful HTML claim would therefore be false. DEVICEV requires preserving the live source and failing closed rather than manufacturing fidelity.
mutation_decision.permitted_output: Persist live/repo XML snapshots, audit, deterministic validator and CI contract only.

final_decision.reason: FINAL_PASS is blocked by repo/live topology mismatch, qualification semantic/control mismatch, unavailable raw-live HTML fidelity, stale copy-contract metadata, stale placement judge identifiers, unresolved current EU admissions and missing unanimous current presentation-judge runs.
final_decision.next_release_condition: Materialize or export the actual current page source; update the repository preview without changing live section order/forms; resolve NeoFort current copy-contract metadata; admit EUs; rebind every claim XPath against the new immutable snapshot; run three replicas of every applicable current judge; then rerun this contract workflow.
